mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite negative FEDFUNDS trend over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in the INDPRO index over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite FEDFUNDS declining and INDPRO increasing over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% in a late-cycle expansion regime predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive when UNRATE drops below 4.5% in late-cycle expansion regime

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2.0% over the past 3 months predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0%

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) simultaneously over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite both PAYEMS and UNRATE rising over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the INDPRO supply index below 100 in a contractionary regime predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive when INDPRO falls below 100 in contractionary regime

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite PAYEMS increasing over the past month.
